name: Aegis Phalanx (Combat)
body:
Those who stand as one stand firmest.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, BAB +5, Aegis Slam, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you gain an additional +1 shield bonus to AC after a creature misses you with a melee attack for 1 round. You may spend an immediate action to grant this bonus to all adjacent allies. They lose the bonus if they stop being adjacent to you.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
